_comment: P2-132 slice (a): the 'Max contracts per account' sizing rule reports currentValue=null while the enforcer reads the live position every sweep. Fix ONLY the per-account cap's currentValue by deriving it from the position data GetAccountSnapshots already gathers. TEST-FIRST: the red tests + the MaxPositionQuantity property stub are already committed (93c6d81) -- two tests are RED (per-account cap reports null not the position; flat reports null not 0) and one is a GREEN negative control (aggregate cap stays null). The loop's job is ONLY (1) populate MaxPositionQuantity in GetAccountSnapshots and (2) read it in the per-account evaluator. The negative-control test TestP2132_AggregateContractCapStillReportsNull guards the (wide) evaluator region: touching the aggregate rule turns it red.

tickets.title: Populate and report the per-account contract cap's live position
tickets.defect: GuardRuleRegistry's 'Max contracts per account' evaluator returns R(null, c.Config.Sizing.MaxContractsPerAccount, ...) -- a hardcoded null currentValue -- while the enforcer reads pos.Quantity every sweep and locks out on 'pos.Quantity > limit'. Measured live on TAKEPROFITPRO524207503: MNQ Long 11 against a cap of 10, MAX_SIZE_BREACH fired, and the inventory still reported currentValue:null while Daily loss limit, Max trades per session and Max consecutive losses all reported where the account stood. The AccountStateSnapshot now carries an int MaxPositionQuantity (added in the test-first commit, default 0) but NOTHING populates it and the evaluator does not read it, so the two P2-132 tests are red.
tickets.spec: Two edits, nothing else. (1) In GetAccountSnapshots, inside the EXISTING `foreach (var pos in state.Positions.Values)` loop that builds PositionString, track the maximum of Math.Abs(pos.Quantity) across the non-Flat positions and assign it to snapshot.MaxPositionQuantity (it stays 0 when the account is flat). Do NOT add a second loop over positions and do NOT change PositionString. (2) In the 'Max contracts per account' evaluator in GuardRules.cs, replace ONLY the null first argument of R(...) with the account's MaxPositionQuantity: R(c.Account == null ? (double?)null : c.Account.MaxPositionQuantity, c.Config.Sizing.MaxContractsPerAccount, c.Account == null ? 0 : 1). The null-account branch must STILL report null. Change NOTHING about the 'Max contracts aggregate' evaluator immediately below it (its currentValue is a cross-account sum, a separate slice -- the negative-control test asserts it stays null), nothing about enforcement, and nothing about the evidenceCount argument (c.Account == null ? 0 : 1) or the Off(...) no-cap branch.

regions.note: Populate MaxPositionQuantity inside the EXISTING `foreach (var pos in state.Positions.Values)` loop that already builds PositionString from pos.MarketPosition/pos.Quantity -- track max Math.Abs(pos.Quantity) over non-Flat positions. One loop, not two; leave PositionString alone.

Replace ONLY the R(null, ...) first argument in THIS rule (Max contracts per account) with c.Account.MaxPositionQuantity, null-account branch staying null. The region also contains the 'Max contracts aggregate' rule and others -- DO NOT TOUCH THEM. TestP2132_AggregateContractCapStillReportsNull goes red if you touch the aggregate.
Read-only context: shows MaxPositionQuantity already exists on the snapshot (added test-first). Do not edit.

expect_green: the per-account contract cap must report the live position (11)
